labels.name: IN_PROGRESS
labels.description: Work has started after its branch, draft pull request, and startup metadata are established.

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: Maintenance or operational work that does not add a user-facing capability.

labels.name: area:tooling
labels.description: Work primarily affecting developer tooling and automation.

labels.name: risk:low
labels.description: Work has limited impact and is straightforward to recover.

labels.name: risk:medium
labels.description: Work has meaningful impact or requires careful validation.

labels.name: risk:high
labels.description: Work has broad impact or significant failure consequences.

labels.name: complexity:low
labels.description: Work is small and has few dependencies.

labels.name: complexity:medium
labels.description: Work spans several related changes or dependencies.

labels.name: complexity:high
labels.description: Work spans many components or has substantial coordination needs.

labels.name: scope:single-repo
labels.description: Work is contained within one repository.

labels.name: automation:manual
labels.description: Work is performed manually without automated execution.

labels.name: automation:automated
labels.description: Work is performed by an automated process.
